image_description: A group of people, mostly young women and girls, are dancing around a tall maypole in a grassy park setting. The maypole is a central vertical structure decorated with long, colorful ribbons (red, blue, yellow, white) that extend from the top to the dancers' hands. The top of the pole features a decorative wreath or floral arrangement. The background consists of green trees and a glimpse of a building.
